title: L’Océan Jouit
description: A very unique, very courageous movie about our species. Not what we are, but what we leave behind. The forest is kind of like our mother and the ocean, our dad.
quote: You awoke the beast in me.
altHero: nude man and woman, who are covered by plants and animal parts including octopus tentacles
alt1: man approaches woman in a foggy forest, she is holding a baby goat
alt4: the couple kissing as pink mist spreads behind them
